sources.title: National Archives of Japan: Twenty-One Demands, January 1915
sources.note: Direct Japanese explanation and treaty catalogue. January18 demands, May7 ultimatum, May9 acceptance after most Group5 demands removed. Do not claim all21 accepted.

sources.title: National Diet Library: Universal Manhood Suffrage and Peace Preservation Law
sources.note: Direct institutional account. March1925 bill, removal of tax requirement, exclusion of recipients of public/private assistance, anti-communist Peace Preservation Law.

sources.title: National WWII Museum: Pearl Harbor Attack, December 7, 1941
sources.note: Direct museum account, background war in China and Nanjing atrocities plus Pearl Harbor. No disputed casualty total repeated.

sources.title: US National Archives: Surrender of Japan (1945)
sources.note: Direct original Instrument of Surrender transcription and archival explanation, September2 Tokyo Bay.

sources.title: US National Archives: Remembering V-J Day, film and photographs
sources.note: Direct indexed original description supports Hiroshima August6, Nagasaki August9 and September2 formal surrender. No single-cause argument for surrender.

sources.title: Office of the Historian: Occupation and Reconstruction of Japan, 1945 to 52
sources.note: Direct archival institutional synthesis, occupation1945 to 1952, land reform, SCAP, treaty ending April1952. Retired page is used for stable historical facts only. Atlas seams independently decoded.

sources.title: National Diet Library: General Elections, April 1946
sources.note: Direct account with contemporary election poster. First postwar general election10April1946, women vote and39 female Diet members.

sources.title: National Diet Library: Constitution of Japan, Japanese text
sources.note: Direct Japanese transcription, Article24 paragraph2 exact 個人の尊厳. Reading kojin no songen; supplied romanization, not printed in source. Text reproduced from document, not a manuscript facsimile. Grouped with English translation and enactment outline.

sources.title: National Diet Library: Constitution of Japan, English translation
sources.note: Direct translation Articles1,4,9,24. Article24 individual dignity exactly matches Japanese sample. November3,1946 promulgation in heading. Grouped with Japanese original and enactment chronology.

sources.title: National Diet Library: Enactment of the Constitution of Japan
sources.note: Direct institutional history confirms May3,1947 entry into force and subsequent legal revisions. Grouped with both constitutional texts conservatively.

sources.title: Edo-Tokyo Open Air Architectural Museum: English guide
sources.note: Direct museum PDF13pages. PDFpage5 House of Okawa1925, rare all-Western rooms around living room; PDFpage8 Kodakara-yu1929, gable, seven lucky gods, lattice dressing-room ceiling. These are preserved specific buildings, not representative of every home.

sources.title: MEXT: School health, safety and school lunches, 1991 white paper
sources.note: Direct historical government report, sections1 and3. 1958 school physicians/dentists/pharmacists;1954 lunch law and preparation/nutrition standards,1956 expansion. No universal attendance inferred.

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Welfare: Universal medical insurance and pensions, 1955 to 1964
sources.note: Direct government historical chapter:1956uninsured30million,1961universalinsurance,1950antibiotics coverage,1951screening/BCG/nurses. Insurance does not mean all care free.

sources.title: CUPNOODLES Museum Yokohama: About Momofuku Ando
sources.note: Direct maker museum history, ChickenRamen1958, garden shed atIkeda, justaddhotwater;1971cupnoodles. Corporate priority and worldwide popularity claims omitted.

sources.title: UNESCO: Washoku, traditional dietary cultures, 2013 inscription
sources.note: Original UNESCO indexed description: rice-cake pounding, symbolicNewYeardishes, specialtableware, families/communities and transmission. Direct page sparse; indexed authoritative text successfully checked. Not all households follow identical customs.

sources.title: TOTO: WASHLET history
sources.note: Direct manufacturer chronology1980warmwatercleansingseat;1983self-cleaningwand. Use dates/functions only, reject unsupported origin-of-bidet or universal hygiene marketing claims.

sources.title: JR Central: Tokaido Shinkansen and conventional lines, Annual Report 2024
sources.note: Direct three-page report; PDFpage3 openingOctober1,1964, conventional regionalrailways commutingwork/school; reporting-yearcontext2024explicit for latter.

sources.title: Okinawa Prefecture: History for children
sources.note: Direct Japanese localgovernment history,1945battle/U.S.rule,returnMay15,1972,continuingRyukyuhistory/culture. No currentterritorialdisputes claims.

sources.title: Japan Meteorological Agency: 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake information
sources.note: Direct indexed JMA historical event page:11March2011earthquake,tsunamidamage,AMeDASobservationsuspendednetwork/powerdamage. Omit magnitude to avoid9.0JMA/9.1USGS conflation.

sources.title: US Foreign Relations, 1941, Far East V: Japanese expansion in Indochina
sources.note: Direct original diplomatic collection contents, July1941southernIndochinadiplomaticdemands and Frenchsubmission. Used to show imported1938JapaneseCambodia/CochinChina features anticipate later occupation, not legitimate sovereignty.
